title: In-house loss creation through intra-group financing
scope: Extend the related-party playbook to losses created by intra-group interest and financing, with the thin-capitalisation candidate route (unverified) and a loss carry-forward pattern

acceptance.text: Findings separate financing-driven losses from operating losses and test alternative explanations
Routes stay unverified candidates or policy gaps
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

evidence.text: ai/tools/financing_losses.py (wired into review_related_party) classifies each loss period as financing-driven, mixed or operating from per-period operating result, related-party interest and other finance cost, and tests and records four alternative explanations (interest vs documented loan terms, third-party finance share, loan documented as funding capital investment, documented loss explanations). financing_driven_losses is raised only when unexplained; related_party_debt_above_reported_ratio above the reported 3:1 ratio with a scope note; a growing loss carry-forward is recorded with the related-party interest it contains. Synthetic scenarios FIN-001..003 (data/synthetic/tax140_financing.json, docs/evidence/TAX-140/scenario_results.json): financing-driven and unexplained, operating losses not attributed to financing, financing-driven but explained by capital investment with an interest discrepancy. tests/ai/test_financing_losses.py 12 OK with LangGraph.

financing_driven_losses routes to unverified candidates CAND-RP-ALLOCATION and CAND-DEDUCTION-TEST; related_party_debt_above_reported_ratio to unverified CAND-THIN-CAP; the interest-free loan signal stays the GAP-ARMS-LENGTH policy gap; no route is eligible for assessment (playbook tests). legal_conclusion is always null.

Recorded here with tests (test_financing_losses 12, related-party tests 21, dev.py check, ruff/format/mypy, agent_eval --check gate PASS with LangGraph after the ADR-017 registry re-pin SYN-PBR-2026.11.4), evidence in docs/evidence/TAX-140, status IN_REVIEW with the PR link.
